positions.as_written: Follow it across consecutive sagittal images to establish its length, since a longitudinal tear runs along the meniscus and its length is the surgical question.
Decide how peripheral it is, because a tear at the capsular margin is in vascular tissue and one at the free edge is not.
Assess the cruciate, because this pattern and a cruciate tear travel together.
Repair outcome depends on factors the imaging does not show, including the patient's age and the cruciate's state, so a repairable appearance is not a prediction.
